text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear priorities. First, make a plan and decide which tasks are most urgent, so you focus on the most important work instead of wasting time on small details. It also helps to manage the scope of a project: if you try to do too much, you may miss the deadline. Finally, communicate with your team, teacher, or manager early if a problem appears. Ask for help, explain the situation, and agree on a realistic solution together. With planning, focus, and honest communication, you can meet deadlines with less stress.
